stem: Jatin's calculator starts at $0$ and has only a $+10$ button. He wants the display to show exactly $80$.

options.text: He needs $8$ presses of the $+10$ button.
He needs $10$ presses, using the button value as the press count.
He can also reach $80$ by mixing $+10$ with other buttons that the calculator does not have.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Only the +10 button is available, so 80 ÷ 10 = 8 presses.

teacher.key_rationale: With only +10 from 0, n presses show 10n; 80 needs 8 presses. Using 10 as the press count swaps button value for presses. Inventing other buttons leaves the single-button scope.
